title.en: Electric 20 vs Electric 40 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Induction motor

h1.en: Electric 20 vs Electric 40 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Induction motor
h1.zh: 电动20和电动40混凝土泵有何不同是目录对照，不是「异步电动机」那一页

directAnswer.en: Electric 20 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 20 lists 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm and aggregate 1–2 cm. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor.
directAnswer.zh: 电动20和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动20标出 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor. Subject: Silniki by Zureks. Electric 20 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Dimensions: Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Electric 40 lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Electric 20 lists entries that Electric 40 does not: Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m. Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm. Max. aggregate size 1–2 cm. Keep the row label with the number. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor。画面主体：Silniki by Zureks。电动20和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动40的 120 m 是细石行里的水平侧。料斗容积：电动20标出 0.25 m³；电动40标出 0.4 m³。电动20有、电动40没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；输送管内径 80 mm；最大骨料粒径 1–2 cm。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Electric 20 lists 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm and aggregate 1–2 cm. Theoretical output: Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Main unit weight: Electric 20 lists 900 kg. Electric 40 lists 2300 kg. Electric 40 lists entries that Electric 20 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Open /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20 and /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40.
body.zh: 电动20标出 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm。电机功率：电动20标出 22 kW；电动40标出 45 kW。外形尺寸：电动20标出 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm；电动40标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。电动40有、电动20没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。

body.en: Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m。理论输送量：电动20标出 8–10 m³/h；电动40标出 21 m³/h。整机重量：电动20标出 900 kg；电动40标出 2300 kg。看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/，看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Both pages use 120 m as a horizontal figure, on different rows. Hopper capacity: Electric 20 lists 0.25 m³. Electric 40 lists 0.4 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The same metre number can sit on a different row. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动20的 120 m 是唯一一组里的水平侧。最大出口压力：电动20标出 10 MPa；电动40标出 23 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same motor power as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 22 kW。电动40标出 45 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same theoretical output as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 8–10 m³/h。电动40标出 21 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 20 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20标出 10 MPa。电动40标出 23 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is pumping distance (h / v) missing on Electric 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动40没有输送距离（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric 40 page does not list that label. Electric 20 lists 120 m / 40 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor.
answer.zh: 电动40这一页没有标出这个标题。电动20标出的是 120 m / 40 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Induction_motor画面里印出的数字。
